faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Sofra OS.

items.question: Does Sofra OS support Arabic?
items.answer: Yes, Sofra OS fully supports Arabic with complete right-to-left layout support alongside English.

items.question: Can I manage multiple branches?
items.answer: Yes, higher-tier plans let you manage multiple branches from a single account.

items.question: Is the system responsive?
items.answer: Sofra OS is fully responsive and works seamlessly on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

items.question: Does it support inventory?
items.answer: Yes, Sofra OS includes full inventory tracking with automatic low-stock alerts.

items.question: Can I export reports?
items.answer: Yes, all reports can be exported for accounting and analysis.
